_note: Machine-readable copy of story/bible.md section 5. tools/art reads this file first. Keep it in sync with the bible.
style: Korean webtoon style, full colour, clean digital linework with soft cel shading, cinematic framing, expressive faces. Palette: warm paper cream, ink black, ash grey, ochre/brass lamp light, cold teal reserved for the Silent, and vermilion reserved only for word power. No purple, no violet, no blue neon

characters.dan: 24-year-old East-Slavic man, 178 cm, lean and slightly hunched, tired but kind face, short messy black hair with a cowlick, dark brown eyes with faint dark circles, round black-frame glasses with a bit of tape on the hinge, light stubble. Rumpled pale-grey button-up shirt with sleeves rolled to the elbows, loosened dark-olive chinos, white sneakers, a mustard-yellow office lanyard around his neck, a yellow carpenter pencil behind his right ear
characters.mira: 23-year-old woman, 168 cm, athletic and wiry, sharp narrow face, olive-tan skin, amber-gold eyes, small scar through her left eyebrow, dark-brown choppy shoulder-length hair tied in a short ponytail with loose strands. Olive-khaki canvas climbing jacket with patched elbows, long cream scarf, black fingerless gloves, ink-black cargo trousers, rust-brown boots, a worn canvas backpack with a coil of rope, a frayed vermilion cord bracelet on her left wrist. Default expression: dry, unimpressed, half-lidded
characters.silent: tall (2.3 m) gaunt humanoid with a smooth, featureless, matte paper-white head and face (no eyes, no nose), a single thin vertical teal seam where a mouth would be. Long arms and long thin fingers like unbound pages. Tattered, faded grey-teal remnants of human clothing, ink-teal drips from the fingertips, body edges dissolving into cold teal shadow
characters.keeper: man of indeterminate age, seen only from the nose down: pale thin face, calm small smile, ink-stained fingertips. Long ink-black robe with a high deep hood that hides the eyes, sleeves embroidered with fine ochre thread script, a brass quill pen tucked in the sleeve
characters.system: a floating rectangular panel of aged cream paper with soft torn edges, a thin double border in vermilion, small notched corners, blank inside (text added later), a faint round ink-stamp seal in the bottom-right corner, slightly tilted 2-3 degrees, casting a soft shadow on the scene; no avatar, no face, never blue, never neon
characters.pip: 11-year-old boy, 138 cm, skinny and quick, light-brown skin, huge dark eyes, a gap between the front teeth, messy sand-coloured hair under a too-big grey flat cap, oversized patched brown coat with rolled sleeves and many pockets, bare ankles, mismatched boots, a small brass hand-bell without a clapper hanging on a string around his neck. Default expression: cheeky sideways grin, one eyebrow up
characters.trader: 50-year-old stout man, 175 cm, round-shouldered, ruddy weathered face, grey stubble, small shrewd friendly eyes, copper-rimmed spectacles pushed up on his forehead, a flat cloth cap, a long leather apron stained black with ink over a patched brown tunic with rolled sleeves, forearms and fingertips permanently dyed black. No text on the apron. Default expression: genial and greedy, weighing everything he sees
characters.lina_human: 14-year-old girl, 150 cm, thin, olive-tan skin like Mira, big amber eyes, long dark-brown hair in two loose braids, a vermilion cord bracelet on her left wrist (bright when seen in memory, faded and frayed later), a plain patched ash-grey dress, bare feet in rope sandals. Default expression: wide-eyed, curious, humming

locations.office-night: open-plan engineering office at 2 AM, empty. Cold fluorescent grey-green light from the ceiling, warm sodium-orange glow of city lights through the big window, a single glowing monitor with blueprint drawings, rolled drawings, a cold coffee mug, cluttered desk; lonely, slightly sickly light
locations.tower-exterior: a colossal bone-white limestone tower rising through cream clouds beyond the frame, spiral balconies, thousands of tiny vermilion glowing glyph-shaped sparks drifting upward like lanterns, empty stone plaza at dusk, sky dusty apricot at the horizon to grey-teal above
locations.corridor: narrow stone corridor, soot-dark brown walls with torn paper pages glued on them, occasional vermilion lantern-words dripping a little light, cold teal darkness at the far end
locations.room: tiny round safe room, ochre walls scratched all over with names, an old mattress and rusty tin cans, a bare lamp hanging from the ceiling whose flame has a vermilion core; warm ochre light, cosy and fragile
locations.hall: a vast colonnade hall of pale stone pillars, dim ash-grey light from high slits, Silent figures standing along the walls with blank faces turned toward the sound, a worn fresco of two girls holding hands near the exit arch
locations.s1e04:hall: huge round library, shelves from floor to a domed ceiling, thousands of glass jars each holding a glowing vermilion word like fireflies, warm amber light, paper-strewn floor, a high-backed dark wooden chair in the centre; behind the chair a sealed door covered with vermilion wax seals
locations.gate: colossal house-high stone arch with no handle or lock, one long line of faint engraved vermilion glyphs above it, cold teal shadows pooling at the base
locations.dungeon: cold bare stone hall with a high black wooden door at the far end, iron bands on the door, teal shadow, ash-grey light
locations.flash: pure white overexposed frame with a faint vermilion crack of light
locations.black: almost entirely black frame, deep ink darkness with only a faint rim light
locations.sky: open sky above the Tower, cream clouds, dusty apricot light fading to grey-teal
locations.s1e06:corridor: the Stair of Echoes: a vast vertical round shaft with a narrow spiral stone stair without a railing, walls covered in thousands of overlapping pale paper sheets like scales, faint ripples of sound visible on the paper, cold teal darkness below, a small warm ochre glow far above
locations.s1e07:street: the Ink Market: a crowded bazaar on a wide landing inside the Tower, crooked wooden stalls under patched paper awnings, hanging glass bottles of black ink and small jars with one vermilion spark each, ochre lanterns, steam, ropes and pulleys, hooded traders; warm and cramped; no readable signs or lettering
locations.s1e08:street: a dead-end stone alley behind the Ink Market: damp soot-dark walls, stacked empty crates and broken ink jars, a single rusty nail in the wall with a scrap of frayed vermilion thread on it, one flickering ochre lantern, cold teal darkness at the far end
locations.s1e08:white: memory scene in warm sepia paper tones, soft blurred paper-grain edges like an old drawing: a tiny cramped family kitchen with one small table, two cups, a few chairs and a small window with soft light (other memory places in this episode: a narrow Tower corridor, the huge round Hall of Words with shelves of jars); only faint vermilion accents
locations.s1e09:tower-exterior: the Wall of Letters: an immense curved inner wall of the Tower made of millions of carved abstract glyph-bricks (unreadable marks, never a real alphabet) and glowing vermilion word-sparks set like bricks, a narrow stone walkway at its foot, one huge endless line of abstract glyphs with a blank gap high near the top, drifting vermilion sparks, dusty apricot light; no readable text anywhere
locations.s1e09:room: a tiny round niche cut into the base of the Wall of Letters: curved walls of abstract glyph-bricks that slowly slot into place by themselves, a bare lamp with a vermilion-hearted flame hanging from the ceiling; warm ochre light, cosy and fragile; no readable text
locations.s1e10:tower-exterior: the stone walkway at the foot of the Wall of Letters at dusk: the curved wall of abstract unreadable glyph-bricks rising behind, a pulsing vermilion gap high above, an ochre lantern on the ground; no readable text
locations.s1e10:corridor: a narrow soot-dark stone corridor ending in a huge black door banded with iron straps (no lettering, no symbols), ochre lantern light, cold teal darkness beyond; torn blank paper pages glued on the walls
locations.s1e10:dungeon: the last hall of the floor: a cold bare stone hall with a high black wooden door banded with iron at the far end, all lamps swept from their hooks and lying broken and unlit on the floor, ash-grey light from high slits, teal shadows, a line of tall Silents standing along the wall; no chair
locations.s1e11:hall: the Hall of Words at the end of its glow: a huge round library with shelves from floor to a domed ceiling holding thousands of glass jars, but the left half of the hall is dark, its jars dim and dead, while the right half still glows amber; a high-backed dark wooden chair in the centre-right; behind the chair a tall sealed door covered with vermilion wax seals (abstract blobs, no markings); paper-strewn floor; no readable text on any jar
locations.s1e11:corridor: a narrow lamp-lit stone passage, low arched ceiling, ochre wall lamps with vermilion-cored flames, a distant amber glow at the far end where the Hall of Words begins; no readable text
locations.s1e12:hall: the Hall of Words in its last hour: a huge round library of glass jars on shelves up to a domed ceiling, the jars flickering and dimming as if breathing out, the high-backed chair empty or half-lit, behind it the tall sealed door covered with vermilion wax seals (abstract blobs, no markings); warm amber light; no readable text
locations.s1e12:sky: open sky above the last door of Floor 1: the huge black iron-banded door has risen into cream clouds like a curtain and a winding stair of pure warm light climbs into the sky; dusty apricot light fading to grey-teal; no readable text anywhere
